test_policy.relevance: Binary customer-product relevance; quantity does not affect relevance.
test_policy.averaging: Macro average across customers with at least one positive test product.

limitations: Product created_at timestamps were not used because the synthetic catalog records were created after the evaluation cutoff.
Availability is checked against the current active and in-stock catalog snapshot, not historical availability at each test order time.
The evaluation measures product relevance against positive test purchases, not clicks or user satisfaction.
The personalized algorithm recommends products previously viewed during training. This evaluates conversion-oriented recommendations rather than unseen-product discovery.
